candidate.startAvailability: Target start availability: late August to early September 2026, subject to USCIS approval and EAD issuance

hero.label: Made for Stryker
hero.headline: Eager to drive growth at Stryker’s Foot & Ankle division.
hero.subheadline: Joining Stryker excites me because it blends my sales expertise with healthcare innovation. Supporting the Foot & Ankle division in Phoenix offers a unique opportunity to impact patient outcomes.

whyCompany.title: Leading innovation in healthcare solutions
whyCompany.body: Stryker is known for its innovative medical technologies improving patient care. I’m excited by the potential to contribute to breakthroughs in orthopedic solutions, especially in foot and ankle care.

whyCompany.title: Growth phase with local impact
whyCompany.body: Stryker is expanding its presence in Phoenix, which is a prime time to join a thriving market. Being part of a growth phase allows for significant personal contribution and development.

whyCompany.title: Aligns with my B2B sales experience
whyCompany.body: My BDR role at Copygen.ai involved building client relationships in a B2B setting, which directly correlates to the skills needed in Stryker’s Foot & Ankle Sales Associate role. I am eager to translate this experience into success at Stryker.

quote: I'm passionate about joining Stryker to help advance healthcare outcomes through innovative sales solutions.
